# s4communication_communication_arrangement (Resource)

Manages an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Communication Arrangement, including the properties of its services.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "s4communication_communication_arrangement" "example" {
  communication_scenario_id = "SAP_COM_0008"
  communication_system_id   = s4communication_communication_system.example.communication_system_id
  name                      = "EXT_API_SAP_COM_0008"
  inbound_user              = s4communication_inbound_user.example.id
  outbound_user             = s4communication_outbound_user.example.id

  # Arrangement properties: property name to values. Only listed properties
  # are managed.
  properties = {
    EXAMPLE_PROPERTY = ["value"]
  }

  # Services are created by SAP from the scenario and are keyed by their ID.
  # Only listed services are managed; unlisted attributes keep SAP's values.
  outbound_services = {
    "EXAMPLE_OUTBOUND_SERVICE" = {
      status   = "INACTIVE"
      url_path = "/api/v1"
    }
  }

  inbound_services = {
    "EXAMPLE_INBOUND_SERVICE" = {
      properties = {
        EXAMPLE_SERVICE_PROPERTY = ["value"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `communication_scenario_id` (String) Communication Scenario ID, e.g. `SAP_COM_0008`. Changing this forces a new arrangement to be created.
- `communication_system_id` (String) Communication System ID (the `communication_system_id` of the system, not its UUID)
- `name` (String) Communication Arrangement Name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Communication Arrangement Description
- `inbound_services` (Attributes Map) Inbound services of the arrangement to manage, keyed by inbound service ID. Services that are not listed are left as SAP created them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inbound_services))
- `inbound_user` (String) UUID of the communication system's inbound user (`s4communication_inbound_user.id`). Adding or removing it forces a new arrangement to be created.
- `outbound_services` (Attributes Map) Outbound services of the arrangement to manage, keyed by outbound service ID. Services that are not listed are left as SAP created them. Attributes that are not configured keep the value SAP assigned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outbound_services))
- `outbound_user` (String) UUID of the communication system's outbound user (`s4communication_outbound_user.id`). Adding or removing it forces a new arrangement to be created.
- `properties` (Map of Set of String) Properties of the communication arrangement. Map of property name to its values. Only the listed properties are managed; properties that are not listed keep their values. Set a property to `[]` to remove its values.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Communication Arrangement UUID

<a id="nestedatt--inbound_services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `inbound_services`

Optional:

- `properties` (Map of Set of String) Properties of the inbound service. Map of property name to its values. Only the listed properties are managed; properties that are not listed keep their values. Set a property to `[]` to remove its values.


<a id="nestedatt--outbound_services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `outbound_services`

Optional:

- `job_frequency` (String) Frequency of the scheduled job
- `job_package_size` (Number) Package size of the scheduled job
- `job_recurrence_value` (Number) Recurrence value of the scheduled job
- `job_start_time` (String) Start time of the scheduled job (`HH:MM:SS`)
- `job_timezone_code` (String) Time zone of the scheduled job
- `properties` (Map of Set of String) Properties of the outbound service. Map of property name to its values. Only the listed properties are managed; properties that are not listed keep their values. Set a property to `[]` to remove its values.
- `soap_wsrm_version` (String) SOAP WS-RM version
- `status` (String) Service status: `active` or `inactive`
- `tcp_port` (Number) TCP port, if different from the communication system
- `url_path` (String) URL path of the service on the communication system

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform 1.12 and later: import with the resource identity, as listed by
# terraform query
import {
  to = s4communication_communication_arrangement.example
  identity = {
    id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Communication arrangement UUID

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Communication arrangements are imported by their UUID
terraform import s4communication_communication_arrangement.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
